verdict.rationale: Grok's own Google Drive connector is documented to search and read files in a user's Drive, so Grok can access document contents from chat. There is no documentation of directly uploading files, of PDF or spreadsheet parsing, or of analysis accuracy. Missing for 10: direct document/PDF/spreadsheet upload in chat or API, documented file-type support and limits, evidence of accurate content analysis, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: The Google Drive connector lets Grok search, read, and manage files in your Google Drive.
Connect your tools so Grok can reach your email, files, and calendar right inside a chat.
